title: Log Anomaly Detector Configuration
description: Example configuration file for the log-anomaly-detector. All fields are optional and will fall back to default values if not provided, except for 'watcher.paths' which must be specified either here or via CLI.

watcher.description: Configuration for the log file watcher.

frequencyAnalysis.description: Configuration for detecting sudden bursts in log volume.

patternAnalysis.description: Configuration for detecting new, unseen log message patterns.

alerter.description: Configuration for where to send anomaly alerts.
